conditions: effective private scope contains exactly one subscription
VS Code Azure credential locally or managed identity when hosted
requested location is valid for the target subscription

decisionPoints.condition: No approved location is supplied or organizational region policy has multiple valid choices.
decisionPoints.question: Which approved Azure region should own the Resource Group metadata?

decisionPoints.question: Should AzureIQ use the existing Resource Group location or stop and plan a differently named group?

methods: dry run
live non-production creation
independent Azure Resource Graph verification
second-run idempotency check
private identifier leak scan

reuse.updatePolicy: Create a new semantic version for behavioral or contract changes; do not silently alter an approved version.

conditions: APIM service, API, operation, UTC incident window, and expected behavior can be identified
mutating request replay is separately approved
tracing limitations are rechecked against the current gateway and workspace model

artifacts.description: Deploy the disposable Waypoint Freight Container Apps and API Management baseline declaratively, with a single workspace, managed-identity registry access and telemetry, Activity Log export, alerts, exact inventory, and supervised teardown metadata.
intents: deploy the Waypoint Freight Azure case-study baseline
create a disposable observable App Service and API Management environment

conditions: effective private scope contains exactly one supervised test subscription
eastus2 supports Container Apps Consumption, ACR Basic, and APIM Developer
the target Resource Group contains no unrelated resources or locks
no soft-deleted API Management service still holds the derived name
the local client can supply an APIM product subscription key at runtime
the optional VNet and private-endpoint phase is not combined with this baseline

parameters.name: environment name, region, Resource Group, publisher metadata, and lifecycle timestamps
exact API deployment ZIP and digest

decisionPoints.condition: The target Resource Group contains resources, locks, ownership tags, or recent changes outside the recorded environment inventory.
decisionPoints.question: Should AzureIQ stop and use a new disposable Resource Group rather than modify the conflicting boundary?

decisionPoints.condition: The derived App Service or API Management name is unavailable or held by an APIM soft-delete record.
decisionPoints.question: Should AzureIQ generate a new unique environment name and rerun validation instead of purging a prior APIM name?

decisionPoints.condition: Provider validation or what-if predicts a delete, replacement, broad role assignment, resource outside the declared boundary, or unregistered resource type.
decisionPoints.question: Should the candidate be revised and revalidated before any deployment approval?

methods: Bicep lint and compilation with pinned Azure Verified Modules
API and client Release builds plus fifteen integration tests
OpenAPI 3.0, APIM policy XML, JSON Schema, and privacy validation
expected-inventory alignment with the declared Container Apps topology

revalidateWhen: any source or application package digest changes
an Azure Verified Module or API contract changes
target region, subscription, Resource Group, SKU, network topology, or identity model changes
policy, quota, provider registration, existing inventory, or APIM soft-delete state changes
reuse.updatePolicy: Keep this version candidate until a full create, verify, teardown, absence check, and recreate cycle succeeds; create a new semantic version for material behavior or topology changes.

artifacts.description: Run protected, stateless backend failure scenarios through Waypoint Freight API Management and correlate client-visible failures with gateway and Container App telemetry.
intents: simulate a backend exception for Azure troubleshooting
distinguish gateway failures from backend failures

conditions: TestScenarios:Enabled is explicitly true on the disposable backend
API Management requires a product subscription and enforces rate limits
Container App ingress accepts only the API Management public IPv4 address
scenario responses are stateless and do not call customer dependencies
request and response bodies remain excluded from telemetry

decisionPoints.condition: The target is not a disposable non-production environment or backend ingress is not restricted to API Management.
decisionPoints.question: Should cloud diagnostic scenarios remain disabled until an isolated protected environment is available?

decisionPoints.condition: A scenario requires a real external dependency or customer data to reproduce the incident.
decisionPoints.question: What isolated synthetic dependency and data are approved for the higher-fidelity scenario?

methods: 15 passing ASP.NET Core integration tests
local HTTP matrix for 200, 404, 409, 429, 500, 503, and 504 responses
correlation header and structured error validation
exception stack trace logging with sanitized client response
OpenAPI 3.0 generation with six paths
client Release build and rendered browser control inspection
source digest and privacy scan

revalidateWhen: scenario behavior or response contracts change
APIM authentication, policy, rate limit, or ingress restriction changes
Container App image or telemetry configuration changes
reuse.updatePolicy: Keep candidate until every scenario is invoked through APIM and independently correlated with gateway and Container App telemetry; create a new version for changed behavior.

protect large language models behind API Management
authenticate to Azure AI models with a managed identity

subscription quota covers the requested model capacity
the target Resource Group is dedicated to this instance
no soft-deleted API Management or Cognitive Services account holds the derived name
callers reach the models only through the gateway product subscription

parameters.name: environment name, region, resource group, and API Management SKU
model deployments with version, SKU, and capacity

decisionPoints.condition: Requested model capacity approaches or exceeds remaining regional quota.

methods: Bicep build and lint with pinned Azure Verified Modules

live model catalog, SKU, and quota confirmation in the target region

anonymous gateway request rejection and least-privilege role scope check

an Azure Verified Module or data plane API version changes
target region, subscription, or resource group changes
gateway policy, authentication, or limits change
